full_details: The jaw took broth and did not take a crust. At eleven Master Kettleby spoke from Somerset House, among the hampers. Sir Thomas's place is unfilled. His lady must render the accounts before any man signs, and the Chamber pays nobody till then. You will be sent for. Whether you will be paid is another office's question. Four persons had spoken to my lord of the king, and he disliked none of the reports. He told you to mend your hose. Through the afternoon you stayed home. The Shrew went up without you. You wrote the cooks into the Capulet house, and the pause was not in the leaf yet. After five the tiring-house door shut. The company goes if it is sent for, and it does not ask for money down. The stock holds six pound, which will carry the boat, the lodging, and the boys' meat for five days, and is not a receipt. At home you set expected against received and wrote no sum.
one_sentence: Kettleby called from among the hampers, you stayed home from the Shrew, and after five the stock was named at six pound.
title: Kettleby called from the hampers, then the tiring-house door shut
